status: experimental specification, not a completed benchmark

independence.rule: Assessor expectations must not be supplied to the assembler as hidden seeds
independence.gold_authoring: Independent domain reviewers required for acceptance; included synthetic starter cases are not independent expert gold
independence.blind_review: Reviewers inspect source evidence before system outputs

comparisons: graph and text without requirement closure

controls.selection: Freeze sources, requests, model, limits and runtime
controls.voice: Start primary comparison at accepted transcript; ASR separate

metrics.definition: Required assessor evidence atoms retained / required assessor atoms; report per case and macro-average; allow explicitly enumerated alternative support sets
Applicable required exceptions retained / applicable assessor exceptions; report no-exception cases separately
Packages marked sufficient but failing independent support or scope criteria / packages marked sufficient; also report numerator / all cases
Independently answerable cases marked insufficient or unknown / independently answerable cases
Supported substantive answer claims / assessed substantive answer claims; human-calibrated evaluator
Same explicit inputs produce identical canonical bytes and content identifier across named runs
UTF-8 bytes of complete package and complete transport envelope reported separately; token counts require named tokeniser
Separate assembly, retrieval, transport and time-to-useful-spoken-answer; p50/p95/p99 with sample size and failures

statistical_plan.sample_size: Determine prospectively by pilot variance and predeclared effect; not invented here
statistical_plan.intervals: Cluster bootstrap intervals or a preregistered suitable alternative
statistical_plan.critical_failures: Report each unauthorised disclosure and omitted required exception, not only averages
statistical_plan.abstention: Report accuracy and coverage jointly; always-abstain is not success

execution_status: not run against real Ask OKF, a model, or a voice client
